description:
Cast Aether Adept without paying its mana cost.
Aether Adept enters the battlefield, targeting itself.
Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Aether Adept.
Token copy of Aether Adept enters the battlefield, returning original Aether Adept to hand.
Resolve the original Aether Adept triggers, fails to resolve due to having no legal targets.
Repeat.
